jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Senior Implementation Manager serves as a senior member of the Implementation Team and is responsible for leading the organization's most complex, strategic, and high-visibility client implementations. This role serves as the primary client-facing partner throughout implementation and provides leadership through execution, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and operational readiness. The Senior Implementation Manager partners closely with Product, Implementation Consultants, Implementation Analysts, Operations, Training, Quality Assurance, Release Management, Account Management, and Executive Leadership to ensure successful implementation outcomes. While this role does not have direct people management responsibilities, it is expected to mentor team members, drive implementation best practices, and serve as an escalation point for complex delivery challenges. The Senior Implementation Manager facilitates implementation planning, monitors progress against agreed-upon milestones, identifies risks and dependencies, and drives cross-functional coordination to support successful client launches.

Responsibilities:

* Serve as the primary implementation lead for the organization's largest, most complex, and highest-profile client programs.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with client stakeholders, executive sponsors, and internal leadership teams.
* Coordinate implementation activities across Product, Operations, Training, Quality Assurance, Release Management, and other cross-functional teams.
* Partner with Product, Portfolio Management, and delivery teams to establish implementation schedules, milestone plans, and dependency tracking.
* Maintain visibility into implementation progress and proactively identify, communicate, and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* Facilitate executive-level client meetings, steering committees, status reviews, and implementation governance sessions.
* Support launch readiness activities by coordinating operational, technical, and client readiness workstreams.
* Drive resolution of complex implementation issues through collaboration, escalation management, and stakeholder alignment.
* Maintain implementation documentation, decisions, action items, risks, and approvals throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Partner with Account Management to support client satisfaction, organizational transitions, and long-term customer success.
* Provide implementation leadership during post-launch stabilization and transition to ongoing operational support.
* Mentor and support Implementation Managers by sharing best practices, providing guidance on complex situations, and promoting consistency across the implementation organization.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives, implementation standards, templates, governance practices, and operational efficiencies.
* Provide implementation status updates, portfolio insights, and risk assessments to senior leadership as required.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* SUCCESS MEASURESSuccessful delivery of strategic and complex client implementations.
* Early identification and mitigation of implementation risks and dependencies.
* Strong client satisfaction and stakeholder engagement.
* Consistent implementation practices across teams.
* Effective cross-functional collaboration and escalation management.
* Successful mentorship and development of implementation team members.
* High-quality launch readiness and post-launch stabilization outcomes.

Qualifications:

* (Preferred) Not provided in source content, add preferred education, experience, certifications, etc.

jobs.description:
**Join Trulieve – Where Passion Meets Purpose**

If you're interested in being part of one of the nation's fastest-growing industries, Trulieve may be the perfect place for you. We are proud to be recognized on **TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 List**, an honor awarded to top-performing U.S. organizations based on employee satisfaction, financial strength, and sustainability transparency. Trulieve was one of only two cannabis companies to receive this distinction.

If you have passion for helping others and want to make a meaningful impact through your work, this may be the role for you. At Trulieve, we strive to bring our patients the relief they need in products they can trust. Our plants are hand-grown in carefully controlled environments designed to minimize unwanted chemicals and pests, keeping the cultivation process as natural as possible every step of the way. To learn more about Trulieve and our mission, please visit www.trulieve.com

**Requisition ID:** 21801

**Remote Work Available:**

**Job Title:** Onboarding Specialist  
**Location:** Tampa, FL / Remote  
**Department:** Talent Acquisition

**Role Summary:**  
Trulieve is seeking a highly organized, customer-focused, and proactive Onboarding Specialist to own and deliver an exceptional onboarding experience for all newly hired employees. This role serves as the primary point of contact for candidates and hiring managers throughout the onboarding journey, ensuring a seamless transition from offer acceptance through Day One and beyond.

The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for managing the full onboarding lifecycle while delivering a white-glove experience that reflects Trulieve's commitment to employee engagement, operational excellence, and service. This position requires a high degree of autonomy, sound judgment, and the ability to independently manage priorities while driving a consistent and positive experience for candidates, new hires, and business leaders. As a key member of the Talent Acquisition team, the Onboarding Specialist continuously evaluates onboarding processes, identifies opportunities for improvement, and partners cross-functionally to enhance employee readiness, engagement, and retention. The ideal candidate is innovative, solutions-oriented, detail-focused, and passionate about creating exceptional first impressions that strengthen Trulieve's employer brand.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Own and manage the end-to-end onboarding experience for all assigned new hires from offer acceptance through successful integration into the organization.
* Deliver a high-touch, white-glove onboarding experience for both corporate candidates and hiring managers, ensuring consistent communication, responsiveness, and support throughout the onboarding journey.
* Serve as the primary onboarding subject matter expert and trusted partner for candidates, hiring managers, Human Resources, IT, Security, and other key stakeholders.
* Proactively communicate with candidates via phone, email, and text to provide guidance, answer questions, and ensure timely completion of onboarding requirements.
* Partner with hiring managers to ensure readiness for new employee start dates, including equipment requests, badge access, workspace preparation, and orientation scheduling.
* Monitor and manage onboarding requests through Zendesk, shared inboxes, and other support channels while maintaining service-level expectations.
* Oversee candidate data management within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and onboarding platforms, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and data integrity.
* Coordinate and track all pre-employment requirements, including background screenings, I-9 documentation, fingerprinting, and other onboarding compliance activities.
* Prepare onboarding schedules and ensure all required resources, systems access, technology, and training requirements are in place prior to employee start dates.
* Maintain regular communication with new hires and managers to assess onboarding effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve the overall experience.
* Develop and maintain onboarding dashboards, readiness reports, and metrics within Smartsheet and other reporting tools.
* Analyze onboarding data and provide recommendations that improve operational efficiency, candidate satisfaction, retention, and engagement.
* Identify process gaps and independently implement improvements to elevate the onboarding experience and support organizational growth.
* Support special projects and onboarding initiatives that enhance the employee experience and strengthen Talent Acquisition operations.
* Exercise independent judgment in managing onboarding priorities while ensuring a high level of customer service and operational excellence.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Skills and Qualifications:**  

* 3+ years of experience in onboarding, talent acquisition, human resources, employee experience, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience managing onboarding programs or employee lifecycle processes in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong knowledge of HR systems, applicant tracking systems, onboarding platforms, and candidate management tools.
* Exceptional customer service mindset with the ability to build strong relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and take ownership of outcomes with minimal supervision.
* Strong project coordination and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Experience analyzing data, maintaining dashboards, and utilizing metrics to drive process improvements.
* Knowledge of HR practices, employment documentation, and compliance requirements.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Smartsheet, and collaboration platforms.
* Ability to pass Level 2 Background Screening.
* Must be at least 21 years old (State Law).

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience supporting high-volume hiring environments.
* Experience with SuccessFactors, Zendesk, or similar HR and onboarding technologies.
* Continuous improvement, project management, or employee experience program exposure.

**Work Schedule:**  

* Full-time salaried position with flexibility to support business and operational needs.
* Must be available to work occasional evenings and weekends if needed.
* Ability to manage workload independently and prioritize responsibilities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

**Success Measures:**  
The successful Onboarding Specialist will:  

* Deliver a best-in-class, white-glove onboarding experience for candidates and hiring managers.
* Maintain high levels of candidate and manager satisfaction throughout the onboarding journey.
* Ensure onboarding milestones and compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, engagement, and retention.
* Act as the owner and champion of the onboarding experience, creating a seamless transition for every new hire joining Trulieve.

Please apply directly through our official careers site or authorized recruitment channels. Using third-party application services may create issues with your applicant profile and lead to processing delays.

Salary will be commensurate with experience. A comprehensive benefits package including paid time off is offered with this position.

**Job Title:** EHR Analyst, Senior  
**Department:** Ambulatory Application  
**Location:** Riedman - Remote  
**Hours Per Week:** 40  
**Schedule:** Full-Time, Day-Shift, Monday to Friday, (8 am - 4:00 pm)

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The EHR Application Analyst Senior serves as an advanced-level contributor in the support, optimization, and ongoing development of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role handles complex technical issues, leads system optimization efforts, and serves as a resource and mentor for junior analysts. The EHR Application Analyst Senior applies deep knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare business workflows to drive improvements that enhance clinical and operational performance.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Advanced System Support and Maintenance:
* Serve as a primary escalation point for complex technical issues and system errors, applying advanced troubleshooting techniques to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to patient care.
* Provide day-to-day technical support to end-users, including troubleshooting issues, answering questions, and resolving system errors to ensure uninterrupted use of the EHR system.
* Provide guidance to junior analysts on day-to-day support challenges, sharing expertise and building team capability.
* Lead and coordinate routine maintenance activities, including software updates, patches, and upgrades, to ensure the stability and security of the EHR system.
* Coordinate testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, ensuring new features meet functional requirements without introducing unintended disruptions.
* Participate in on-call rotations, including taking lead responsibility for after-hours coverage on complex or escalated issues.

System Optimization:

* Lead efforts to optimize the performance, usability, and efficiency of the EHR system.
* Conduct workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and advance optimization requests through appropriate governance and change management channels.
* Apply cross-application integration knowledge to identify dependencies and ensure cohesive system performance across modules.

Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:

* Take ownership of defined work streams or components within EHR implementation projects, system upgrades, and other initiatives.
* Coordinate task assignments, track progress, and communicate status to project leads, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and within scope.
* Own ongoing relationships with EHR vendor support, including managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and representing the organization in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams - including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors - to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication across stakeholder groups.

Documentation and Knowledge Management:

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
* Establish knowledge-sharing practices to ensure critical information is accessible and current across the team.

Training and Mentorship:

* Provide training and mentorship to junior analysts and end-users, sharing best practices to enhance team capabilities and support continuous professional development.

Compliance and Data Privacy

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.
* Complete required compliance training and model information security best practices for the team.

* Excellent analytical, organization, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within teams.
* Ability to solve complex problems and understand translate customer needs into system solutions.

* Cross-application integration knowledge.

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote- Eligible US Locations

**About the role and about You:**

Great support starts with great training. When our members hit a snag, our Community Support team gets them back into Watopia and helps them make the most of their Zwift experience. To help support our frontline agents, we're hiring a hands-on Training Specialist to build and maintain the training they rely on.

Our training program already has a strong foundation: a structured new hire curriculum, an established design framework, and experienced subject matter expert trainers who facilitate instructor-led training. In this role, you'll keep that program accurate and effective as Zwift evolves. When products, processes, or policies change, you'll revise new hire training and build and deploy update training to match. When the team identifies a need for refresh training, you'll build it. When something new and complex launches, you'll be a crucial part of supporting it.

You'll be a part of our Content & Learning team, who own training, user-facing self-service content, and the internal knowledge enabling Zwift's support team. In this role, you'll also be the subject-matter expert in Seismic, our learning management system, ensuring we're maximizing the benefits of the tool, keeping groups and enrollments clean, tracking completion and assessment results, and partnering with our BPO partners to close gaps.

You're organized, dependable, and easy to work with. You take direction well, own your work from start to finish, and partner effectively with your teammates. You know when to hold firm on accuracy and when to flex on format or timing. You're comfortable working outside a defined box: you pick up new tools, figure things out on your own, take on new work as the team's needs change, and handle shifting priorities with ease. You use AI thoughtfully, knowing where it speeds up work and where human validation is essential.

**What you'll do:**

* Develop new eLearning and instructor-led training (including exams and certifications) to support product launches and updated policies and procedures, while keeping existing training current.
* Build and deploy refresh training when the team identifies a need, indicated by QA results, Customer Effort Scores, or related performance data.
* Host train-the-trainer sessions to prepare subject matter expert (SME) trainers for seasonal new hire classes and update training rollouts.
* Run regular audits of training materials with SMEs to catch inaccurate, outdated, or missing information.
* Build and sustain strong working relationships with SME trainers, partner teams, and BPO leaders, rooting feedback in curiosity and respect while openly receiving it in return.
* Own Seismic (our LMS): managing distribution groups, reporting on completion and assessment results, and working with BPO leaders to close gaps. Explore unused and emerging features, while recommending ones worth adopting.

**What we're looking for:**

* 2+ years of instructional design, training, or learning and development experience.
* Experience building eLearning, instructor-led training, and assessments using ADDIE or a similar model, with tools such as Articulate or Camtasia.
* Familiar with Kirkpatrick or a similar model for measuring training effectiveness.
* Experience as an LMS administrator using tools like Seismic (formerly Lessonly), Docebo, or equivalent, including user groups, enrollments, and reporting.
* Experience facilitating virtual training, including train-the-trainer sessions, ideally with globally distributed or BPO teams.
* Flexibility with an eagerness to support your team beyond training when priorities shift, whether for a short-term need or a longer-term change in focus.

**Bonus points:**

* A passion for cycling, running, or fitness.
* Experience supporting both internal and BPO (outsourced) contact center teams.
* Familiarity with Zwift, gaming, the software industry, or fitness technology.
  

*I**f Zwift determines in any stage of our interviews that any AI tools are being used without disclosure or citation, your candidacy will be disqualified.*

  

**For All US Based Full-Time Positions:**

The base salary for this position ranges between$56,500- $88,500. The base salary will be based on a number of factors including the role offered, the individual's job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, Zwift is proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package for all eligible employees which also includes performance bonuses, equity, and a full range of medical, financial, and other perks and benefits.

**How to stand out among the rest:**

Your resume/CV is enough to show off your skills, accomplishments, and experience. However, if you choose to include a cover letter introducing us to your awesome personality, we will read that too.

We strongly believe that different backgrounds and ideas are a competitive advantage; we hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. Zwift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by emailing careers@zwift.com.

jobs.title: SAP SuccessFactors Implementation Project Manager - 100% REMOTE
jobs.description:
Description:

Come make an impact in the Public Sector! Join our team to do meaningful work and support high-impact government missions.

**GP Strategies Government Solutions, Inc.** Government Training Solutions | GP Strategies, a wholly owned subsidiary of GP Strategies Corporation, focuses on helping every public sector team unlock its full potential through people performance solutions.

Our work directly supports mission critical government agencies, including:

* Air Force
* Army
* Department of Defense (DoD)
* Department of Health & Human Services (HHS)
* Department of Homeland Security
* NASA
* National Highway Institute (NHI) | Federal Highway Administration (FHWA)
* State & Local Governments

Our Mission is meaningful and powerful: to deliver innovative people performance through off the shelf and custom learning, mission specialists, and technology solutions, building deep partnerships with customers to help them achieve measurable mission and company performance improvements.

GP Strategies Corporation, the corporate parent of GP Strategies Government Solutions, is a global leader in talent transformation, dedicated to empowering organizations to unlock their full potential. We help businesses enhance workforce performance and achieve strategic goals through innovative, technology-enabled learning solutions. For over 50 years, with a proven track record of supporting over 6,000 global organizations worldwide, we combine human expertise with AI-driven insights to deliver customized strategies that upskill talent, drive technology adoption, and optimize critical processes.

GP Strategies Government Solutions is seeking an **SAP SuccessFactors Implementation Project Manager.** This is a full-time, remote, benefitted position. The Project Manager is capable of simultaneously managing all aspects of assigned projects, interfacing with the client, project team members, and senior management to meet both client and company expectations. The SuccessFactors Project Manager is expected to manage and deliver large and small-scale IT projects on time and within budget while overseeing all phases from project planning to project closure.

**Role and Responsibilities**

Operational

* Capable of wearing multiple hats simultaneously (i.e., strategic, and operational)
* 5 or more years’ experience with PMO team management, sales support, quality control, account management, operations management, team management (10 or more), project management (3 or more simultaneously)
* Facilitate/support Client Relationship Management shared with sales/others where applicable
* Experienced and capable of managing Organic Growth (upsell scope, projects, support)
* Facilitate/support Customer Satisfaction/Referenceable
* Facilitate/support SAP/NS2 relationships, strategic relationships, internal relationships
* Able to manage dedicated resources and shared resources across peer verticals & horizontal business units.
* Able to lead, mentor, and support project managers overseeing the successful deployment and delivery of SAP SuccessFactors projects.
* Ability to manage difficult high stress client escalations and negotiations.
* Manage the team ensuring quality and cost-effective services are provided.
* Ability to Identify and deploy process, system, execution, documentation, etc. improvements.
* Ability to collaborate with and solicit (open to) input from senior leadership, peers, directs, external partners, and customers.

Project Accountability

* Serve as the single point of accountability for all aspects of their assigned project(s).
* Direct and control all activities to align on and meet client expectations and meet budgeted financial objectives tied to the project.
* Track all project costs to budget, project progress to schedule, and prepare cost-to-complete reports.
* Obtain required approvals for documentation, stage gates, etc. (e.g. requirements, workbooks, testing results, etc.).

Project Execution

* Project Preparation: Create project plans, create kick off presentations, forecasting, resource plan, sales to delivery hand off, client engagement, etc.
* Maintain project documentation and prepare/deliver project progress reports.
* Conduct internal project review meetings and act as project information source.
* Perform final review of deliverables.
* Monitor project deliverables to ensure quality is maintained.
* Ensure that deliverables are on time, and on/under budget.
* Identify and mitigate project risks.
* Develop and maintain detailed project schedules and project forecasts for resource planning.
* Manage project scope and change management activities.

Project/Client Communication

* Manage and lead client communications.
* Establish a trusted partner relationship with client project stakeholders.
* Serve as the primary client interface for project schedule, budget, and scope.
* Maintain routine communications with the management concerning all aspects of the project.
* Support the development of proposals by providing estimates for support activities.
* Strive to identify organic growth opportunities with the client.

Resource Management

* Coordinate and direct the staff assigned to the project, i.e. the project team.
* Maintain a positive working environment with the project team.
* Coach, counsel, and mentor project team members on project related.
* Identify and help determine resources needed on potential projects.

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 5+ years managing projects, including defining project scope and budget, creating project plans, managing project resources, issue resolution, and reporting status.
* Experience managing SuccessFactors full-suite implementations.
* Experience managing ECP payroll implementations.
* Experience using project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet’s, etc.
* Experience using resource and financial management tools such as Oracle, Salesforce, etc.
* Detailed and results oriented individual who takes initiative to solve problems and overcome roadblocks in a timely manner.
* Ability to communicate with team members and customers clearly, concisely, and confidently, both verbal and written.
* Ability and desire to share knowledge with customers and mentor the project team.
* Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
* Ability to work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving, fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work closely with multiple internal and external organizations.
* Ability to multitask while managing multiple technical projects, oversee daily project operations, and support other projects in a contributor role.
* US Citizen
* Able to pass background checks and public trust clearance if/when needed for assignments.
* Ability to travel up to 25% as needed.

Preferred:

* Experience implementing EC for existing SAP ECC Payroll customers remaining on ECC Payroll.
* Experience with ECC Payroll to ECP Payroll implementations.
* Willing to remain current with SAP/SuccessFactors HCM technologies.
* Knowledgeable in current HR policies, practices, and ability to anticipate future trends affecting the business from a systems and process perspective.

Plus:

* Experience configuring, implementing, and supporting one or more SAP HCM/Payroll and or SuccessFactors modules.
* Ability to elicit and document business requirements.
* Knowledge of technical data processing procedures, policies, and best practices.

Requirements:

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

**General physical requirements needed to perform the essential functions of this job may vary based on location of assignment.**

***Assignment Location – Remote***

* Sedentary Work – Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body.
* Typing, communicating, repetitive motions.
* Close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data, view computer monitors and read. May need to view presentation screens and other visual aids in a virtual setting.
* Inside environmental conditions with protection from outside elements.

*At GP Strategies Government Solutions culture focuses on performance and revolves around respect, fairness, and working collaboratively to achieve our goals. We support our People, no matter who they are or where they are from, because we all have valuable and unique perspectives and approaches. That's how great ideas are born, which enable us to work smarter.*

*GP Strategies Government Solutions is committed and proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related conditions, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other federally protected class.*
